title: Long conversation with successful rollover

turns.prompt: Our objective for today: migrate the deploy script from bash to bun. Please read the file ./deploy.sh first so you know the current state.
Now write the bun version to ./deploy.ts with the same rsync behaviour.

script.content: Done. deploy.ts now uses Bun.$ rsync to mirror dist/ to the server.

turns.prompt: Important correction: never deploy straight to production; always deploy to staging first. Acknowledge.

script.content: Acknowledged. Corrections stored: staging-first deploy, production only after staging passes.

turns.prompt: Open item: the staging server credentials are still missing. Keep that open. Also we decided to keep rsync instead of scp. Acknowledge both.

script.content: Acknowledged. Open item: staging credentials missing. Decision: keep rsync, drop scp.

turns.prompt: Verification: run a dry-run of the new script; it passed locally. Then summarize the plan.

script.content: Dry-run passed. Plan: bun deploy.ts mirrors dist/ to staging; production only after staging verification.

turns.prompt: Given everything decided so far, what is the deploy plan and which correction must we respect?

script.content: Plan: bun deploy.ts -> staging via rsync; production later. Respect the staging-first correction.

extractionRecords.text: Migrate the deploy script from bash to bun (deploy.ts mirrors dist/ via rsync).
Keep rsync; drop scp. CI-free local deploy flow.
Never deploy straight to production; staging first, production after staging passes.
Dry-run of bun deploy.ts passed locally.

notes: Primary retention scenario: objective/decision/correction/open_item/verification all introduced before the first rollover.
